role: Independent methodological review; no official forecast, probability or fitted similarity score

principal_recommendation.conclusion_ko: 현재 한국은 관측 고점 이후 큰 첫 하락, 상당한 반등, 첫 저점의 소폭 재이탈까지 진행됐다. 낙폭만 맞추면 2008년3월이지만 반등 순서와 경과시간은 같은 위치가 아니다. 중국2007년10월~2008년1월은 작은 반등 기준에서 사건순서와 시간상 가깝고, 큰 반등 기준에서는2008년4~6월이 별도 후보가 된다. 모든 차원을 안정적으로 만족하는 단일 날짜는 확인되지 않는다.

definitions_to_keep_separate.name: depth_match
definitions_to_keep_separate.definition: Current close/observed peak minus1. Historical first crossing of today's Korean threshold is March18,2008.
definitions_to_keep_separate.limitation: No requirement of a prior rebound, elapsed time or prior-low breach; insufficient for stage equivalence.

definitions_to_keep_separate.name: stage_match
definitions_to_keep_separate.definition: Observed peak→confirmed or explicitly retrospective trough→rebound peak→prior-trough breach, with each anchor's confirmation timestamp distinguished.
definitions_to_keep_separate.limitation: Depends on turn threshold and can recur multiple times within one historical episode.

definitions_to_keep_separate.name: complete_underwater_correction
definitions_to_keep_separate.definition: A close peak until the first later close regains that same level; the lowest close within that full spell is the completed correction trough.
definitions_to_keep_separate.limitation: Different from the first trough and first rebound of a zigzag. Current spell remains incomplete at the cutoff.

definitions_to_keep_separate.name: price_vs_running_trough
definitions_to_keep_separate.definition: Current close relative to the minimum close observed so far.
definitions_to_keep_separate.limitation: At a fresh low it is zero by construction and does not measure the preceding rebound amplitude.

core_stage_comparisons.facts: May29 peak4334.92→June4 first low3670.40→June19 rebound4269.52→July5 new low3615.87→July26 prior peak regained.
core_stage_comparisons.interpretation: A failed first rebound and marginal new low can occur within a bull-market correction. This is a counterexample to deterministic new-low→collapse logic.
core_stage_comparisons.differences_vs_korea: Initial decline15.33%, rebound16.32%,90.16% of initial loss recovered;27sessions peak→new-low versus Korea39.06% drawdown,26.59% rebound,42.24% recovered,77sessions. Smaller and faster episode.
core_stage_comparisons.vintage: Completion and later October peak are known only in hindsight; not an independent sample of a new national boom.

core_stage_comparisons.facts: Oct16 peak6092.06→Nov28 first low4803.39→Jan14 rebound5497.90→Jan22 new low4559.75.
core_stage_comparisons.interpretation: Under10% directional-change confirmation, event order and duration resemble current Korea.
core_stage_comparisons.differences_vs_korea: First decline21.15%, rebound14.46%,53.89% initial-loss recovery;68sessions peak→new-low. Korea's decline is much deeper, rebound larger, and time77sessions. The14.46% rebound fails15/20% confirmation.
core_stage_comparisons.economic_context: Chinese financial tightening, equity supply and high lagged annual-earnings valuation were present; 2007-08 global credit stress is a separate external confound. Full-year2007 earnings were published after the peak.

core_stage_comparisons.case: China March-April2008 deep decline before May rebound
core_stage_comparisons.facts: March18 first passed Korea's39.06% drawdown threshold; April18 trough3094.67 was49.20% below Octpeak.
core_stage_comparisons.interpretation: March18 is a useful depth comparison but precedes the later large rebound and its failure. It does not alone match Korea's completed rebound/new-low stage.
core_stage_comparisons.economic_context: PBC's February2008 report still described tight policy and inflation concerns. Annual profit figures and forward EPS revisions require their own availability records.

core_stage_comparisons.case: China April-May-June2008 large rebound then renewed decline
core_stage_comparisons.facts: April18 low3094.67→May5 rebound3761.01(+21.53%)→June10 first close below April low3072.33. Rebound peak confirmed under15% onJune10 and20% onJune12.
core_stage_comparisons.interpretation: Passes larger-bounce filters and resembles a sizable failed rebound with new-low breach, but is deeper and much later relative to the peak.
core_stage_comparisons.differences_vs_korea: Only22.23% of original loss recovered;159sessions from peak to first breach versus Korea42.24% and77sessions. June10 old-trough breach0.72% is close to Korea0.70%, but drawdown49.57% is much deeper.
core_stage_comparisons.economic_context: An official stamp-tax cut took effectApril24, within this rebound. This shows policy direction can change during a bear market; price sequence alone cannot isolate the tax effect. Lehman's September event must not be used as information available at the May or June anchors.

method_review.prefix_only_turn_confirmation: Independently implemented10/15/20% running-extremum reversals; corresponding Chinese and Korean extrema/confirmation dates agree with prices/phase_analysis.py logic. No future observations are needed to confirm a turn after its stated confirmation date.
method_review.matching_feature_warning: Current Korea makes a fresh low, so bounce_from_running_trough and loss_recovered_from_running_trough both equal0. These are current-position descriptors, not the preceding rebound shape.
recommended_additional_descriptors: last confirmed rebound close / preceding confirmed trough close minus1
(rebound high - preceding trough)/(original peak - preceding trough)
method_review.no_aggregate_score: Retain per-feature distances and explicit thresholds. Do not silently average dimensions or choose weights to obtain a favorite date.
method_review.sensitivity_reading: Failure of strict/base intersections is evidence of no close match under those declared rules; it is not proof that every conceivable alignment is unrelated. Loose10% matches need special disclosure because15/20% states differ.
method_review.prior_exposure: Earlier research already inspected2008, so this is not a blind preregistration; input source and current cutoff can still be frozen and audited.
method_review.candidate_universe_warning: Exhaustive post-October2007 Chinese candidates condition on a retrospectively observed cycle high. They do not establish that Korea June22 is a permanent final top, nor do they exhaust every pre-peak correction in2005-07. Keep the May-July2007 recovery case as a separate counterexample and state the candidate universe whenever using nearest/exhaustive language.

falsification_and_updates.condition: Korean close rapidly regains5593.56 prior-trough level
falsification_and_updates.effect: Weakens interpretation of a persistent breakout/downward continuation. One reclaim alone does not restore the earlier trend; the break was only0.70% at cutoff.

falsification_and_updates.condition: Subsequent prices regain the September23 rebound high7080.92 before a materially deeper low
falsification_and_updates.effect: Weakens the observed failed-rebound continuation analogy and favors a more complex base/correction path.

falsification_and_updates.condition: Subsequent prices regain the observed June22 peak9114.55
falsification_and_updates.effect: Invalidates treating June22 as a durable final top over that observed horizon; the May-July2007 recovery counterexample becomes more relevant.

falsification_and_updates.condition: A lower rebound high is followed by another lower low while same-definition EPS levels are revised down and funding/foreign flow stress broadens
falsification_and_updates.effect: Strengthens an ongoing bear-phase mechanism; still does not calibrate a probability from the single China episode.

falsification_and_updates.condition: Actual AI-memory orders, prices, margins and cash flow keep supporting earnings while broad market participation improves
falsification_and_updates.effect: Weakens a Chinese-style fundamental deterioration mechanism even if some chart stages remain visually similar.

falsification_and_updates.condition: Historical data series definitions, available_at records or the current source vintage change
falsification_and_updates.effect: Recompute within a new version; preserve the frozen prior prices and report rather than rewriting them.

causal_limits: A megatrend can remain real while the market discounts slower future growth; trailing earnings and valuations cannot be mechanically assigned causal price contributions.
2007 SSE lagged annual EPS PER, current Korean forward PER and realized profit aggregates are not interchangeable.
China's capital controls, state-enterprise index mix, listing supply and lack of the later formal margin-trading mechanism differ from Korea.
The global credit crisis is an external time-varying confound. Comparing2008 continuation outcomes without matching the external shock overstates recurrence.
Several dates and windows from2007-08 are highly dependent observations from one historical path. Candidate count is not sample size.
No hypothetical Korean future line, occurrence probability or target price follows from a stage label.
